## 📝 Summary
Describe the problem, the proposed change, and why it belongs in this educational repository.

## 🎯 Change type
- [ ] 📚 Documentation
- [ ] 📓 Notebook
- [ ] 🧬 Modeling methodology
- [ ] 🗃️ Dataset/provenance
- [ ] 🧪 Tests/validation
- [ ] 🔐 Security/privacy
- [ ] ⚙️ CI/tooling

## 🔍 Technical details
Explain affected files, behavior, assumptions, and alternatives considered.

## 🧪 Verification evidence
| Command / check | Environment | Exit code / outcome |
|---|---|---|
| | | |

State explicitly what was not tested. Do not claim checks passed if they were not run.

## 🧬 Model integrity (when applicable)
- [ ] Target and predictors are explicitly separated.
- [ ] Identifier and target are excluded from X.
- [ ] Learned preprocessing is fitted only on training folds.
- [ ] Held-out data was not used for tuning.
- [ ] Positive class and metrics are defined.
- [ ] Limitations and uncertainty are documented.
- [ ] No clinical claims are made.

## 🗃️ Data and licensing (when applicable)
- [ ] Source, version, license, attribution, and checksum recorded.
- [ ] No private or identifiable health data included.
- [ ] Dataset change record updated.

## 🔐 Security and privacy
- [ ] No credentials or sensitive information committed.
- [ ] Notebook code and workflow permissions reviewed.

## 📚 Documentation
- [ ] README and docs index updated.
- [ ] Local links and diagrams checked.
- [ ] Known issues and changelog updated where appropriate.
